sheets.title: LEGEND GENERAL NOTES AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Standard electrical legend and abbreviations sheet for the 4-sheet drawing set. Covers symbols for conduit, panelboards, GFCI/GFCI receptacles, equipment connections, motor connections, disconnect switches, and branch circuit notation. Abbreviation list covers standard electrical acronyms (GFCI, MCB, MLO, SPGFCI, XFMR, etc.). Firm: Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc., Norfolk VA / Chesapeake VA. Drawn/Designed by: AJR; Checked by: MED. Sheet 1 of 4. No schedule or keyed note index on this sheet.

sheets.title: SITE PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Site plan at 1"=10'-0" showing the splash pad area relative to existing in-ground pool, pool equipment building, and existing structure. Key elements: (1) Proposed Splashpad shown as a new area labeled 'PROPOSED SPLASHPAD' east of the existing structure. (2) Phase I/Phase II delineation shown — Phase I 'COMPLETE', Phase II 'NEW'. (3) 1" empty conduit for feature bollard power and controls runs from equipment building area to splash pad. (4) Existing underground balance tank shown. (5) Feature Bollard noted with instruction to 'COORDINATE CONNECTION REQUIREMENTS WITH MANUFACTURER; ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR RESPONSIBLE FOR FINAL TERMINATIONS.' (6) Fence — ETR (existing to remain). (7) Existing in-ground pool and pool equipment building labeled as existing. Two-phase project structure: Phase I was the existing pool/equipment side (complete); Phase II is the new splashpad electrical service.

sheets.title: FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Floor plan of pool equipment building at 1/2"=1'-0". Rooms: Chemical Room, Filter Room, Storage & Guard Room, Pump Pit. Equipment identified with circuit designations from Panel 'A': (a) Feature Filtration Pump — 480V, 3Ø, 7.5HP, 9.7A (circuit A-24); (b) Filtration Pump — 480V, 3Ø, 7.5HP, 9.7A (circuit referenced); (c) Feature Pump — 208V, 3Ø, 10HP, 28.7A; (d) Feature Timer Panel — 120V; (e) CO2 Tank + CO2 Controller (120V ETR — existing to remain) (circuits A-1R); (f) CO2 Controller, 120V; (g) Chemical Controller, 120V; (h) UV Sterilizer & Ozone Feeder, 120V; (i) Chemical Dispenser — ETR; (j) Feature Sand Filter (labeled 'FFFDER'); (k) Sand Filter — ETR. Key Note 1: See power riser diagram for additional information. Also shows 1" sleeve for feature bollard and 1" empty conduit for feature bollard power and controls running to exterior. Circuit designations reference Panel 'A'. Note: 'BYP/TR' abbreviation appears; likely Bypass/Timer Relay. Panel 'A' feed shown going to filter room equipment.

sheets.title: PANELBOARD SCHEDULE AND RISER DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: Two power riser diagrams (demolition and new work) plus Existing Panelboard 'A' Schedule. POWER RISER DEMO: Shows existing 750kVA pad-mounted utility transformer feeding a service disconnect (208/120V, 3Ø), which feeds Panel 'A' (300A) and Pool Room. Emergency stop switch shown. Existing primary/existing secondary labeled. POWER RISER NEW WORK: Same transformer and service disconnect remain. Panel 'A' retains 300A feed. New work adds: motor starter (typ., UON) to Pool Room; external emergency stop switch; GFCI receptacles and SPGFCI devices in pool room; feature timer panel connection to splash pad. Key Notes (this sheet only): (1) Replace all materials with LMI or PVC where possible; (2) Remove all corroded electrical distribution equipment — retain all feeders and circuits for reuse in new work; (3) Remove existing feeder from nearest accessible point; (4) Remove feeder to nearest accessible junction box; retain feeders to source for reuse; (5) Provide 3-#10 AWG & 1-#12 AWG GND, 1"C to nearest accessible junction box or wireway; connect to feeders retained from demolition; (6) Provide 304 stainless steel enclosures for all equipment. PANELBOARD 'A' SCHEDULE: 100A, MCB, 208/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire, unknown kAIC, surface mount. Manufacturer: Cutler-Hammer POW-R-LINE series. Loads include: Spray Field Pump, Filtration Room feeder, Pump 200V feeder, Ext. Fan, Lights, Outdoor Lights, Pool Outlet, Outlets, Pool/Rec Band Light, Rec Feature Timer Panel (1.5, 20/1, 12). Note: Panel schedule header says 100A MCB; riser diagram shows 300A feeder from service disconnect to Panel 'A' — possible conflict or panel 'A' is a sub-panel with 100A main breaker. BFA scope appears to be electrical engineering only, connecting new splash pad feature loads to existing distribution.

claims.value: 300A feeder from service disconnect to Panel 'A'

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: Panel 'A' is a 100A main-breaker sub-panel fed by a 300A feeder from the service disconnect. The 300A feeder likely serves multiple panels; Panel 'A' is one branch.
conflict_flags.rationale: Riser diagram shows Panel 'A' as one branch of the service disconnect; the 300A is the main service feeder ampacity, not Panel 'A' main breaker size. Minor inconsistency in how the riser was drawn vs. the panel schedule.
